policy.method: Direct frame0 grayscale NCC of RGB context patches; reverse registration; rope-only RGB normal refinement. No optical-flow or neural model, no disparity input.
policy.missing_policy: Failed/ambiguous locations remain null; no interpolation, smoothing, along-rope rescue, or threshold changes. Successful context registration does not prove a unique material-point identity or uncontaminated rope pixels.
